cards.example_en: The content of the note on the fridge surprised the whole family.
cards.example_zh: 冰箱上那张便条的内容让全家人都吃了一惊。

cards.example_en: She entered a writing contest.
cards.example_zh: 她参加了写作比赛。

cards.example_en: The joke only makes sense if you know the context from yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 只有知道昨天的上下文，这个笑话才讲得通。

cards.example_en: Asia is the largest continent.
cards.example_zh: 亚洲是最大的洲。

cards.example_en: Dad read every line of the contract before he signed his name.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸签名之前，把合同的每一行都读过了。

cards.example_en: The two reports are contradictory.
cards.example_zh: 两份报告互相矛盾。

cards.example_en: I thought he was shy; the contrary is true.
cards.example_zh: 我以为他害羞，事实正相反。

cards.example_en: There is a sharp contrast between rich and poor.
cards.example_zh: 富人和穷人之间存在着鲜明的对比。

cards.example_en: Our class's contribution of rice and noodles filled two large boxes.
cards.example_zh: 我们班捐助的大米和面条装满了两个大箱子。

cards.example_en: A conventional oven takes longer than our microwave at home.
cards.example_zh: 家里的传统烤箱比微波炉花的时间更长。

cards.example_en: I can convince him to join our team.
cards.example_zh: 我能说服他加入我们队。

cards.example_en: Reading is the core of this lesson.
cards.example_zh: 阅读是这节课的核心。

cards.example_en: She works in a corporate office.
cards.example_zh: 她在一家公司的办公室上班。

cards.example_en: They correspond by email every week.
cards.example_zh: 他们每周用电子邮件通信。

cards.example_en: She wore a historical costume on stage.
cards.example_zh: 她在台上穿着历史服装。

cards.example_en: The cottage stands beside the lake.
cards.example_zh: 小屋立在湖边。

cards.example_en: The town council agreed to repair the bridge before winter.
cards.example_zh: 镇理事会同意在入冬之前修好那座桥。

cards.example_en: Our county holds a big fair with races and homemade cakes.
cards.example_zh: 我们郡会举办大型集市，有比赛，也有自制蛋糕。

cards.example_en: Rain moved our tennis match onto the indoor court.
cards.example_zh: 一下雨，我们的网球赛就改到了室内球场。

cards.example_en: The news coverage of the match was clear.
cards.example_zh: 这场比赛的新闻报道很清楚。

cards.example_en: The bike did not crash into the wall.
cards.example_zh: 自行车没有撞到墙上。

cards.example_en: Colour the map with a crayon.
cards.example_zh: 用蜡笔给地图上色。

cards.example_en: Would you like cream in your coffee?
cards.example_zh: 你的咖啡要加奶油吗？

cards.example_en: A tiny creature moved under the leaf.
cards.example_zh: 一只小生物在叶子下移动。

cards.example_en: Paying the phone bill on time improved Dad's credit at the bank.
cards.example_zh: 按时交电话费，改善了爸爸在银行的信用。

cards.example_en: The stage crew moved the piano during the interval.
cards.example_zh: 负责舞台的全体人员在中场休息时挪走了钢琴。

cards.example_en: Spraying paint on the school wall is a crime, not a joke.
cards.example_zh: 往学校墙上喷漆是罪行，不是开玩笑。

cards.example_en: A burst pipe created a crisis in the science lab before lunch.
cards.example_zh: 一根水管爆了，午饭前理科实验室陷入了危机。

cards.example_en: Neat labels were the main criterion for winning the science fair.
cards.example_zh: 标签工整是科学展评奖的主要标准。

cards.example_en: The injured player was in a critical condition that night.
cards.example_zh: 那名受伤的球员当晚伤势危急。

cards.example_en: Don't criticise people in public.
cards.example_zh: 不要当众批评别人。

cards.example_en: Hail flattened the tomato crop in my uncle's greenhouse.
cards.example_zh: 冰雹砸倒了我叔叔温室里的番茄作物。

cards.example_en: A large crowd waited outside the stadium.
cards.example_zh: 一大群人在体育场外等候。

cards.example_en: Sleep is crucial for good health.
cards.example_zh: 睡眠对身体健康至关重要。

cards.example_en: It is cruel to hurt an animal.
cards.example_zh: 伤害动物是残酷的。

cards.example_en: Cantonese cuisine is famous worldwide.
cards.example_zh: 粤菜闻名世界。

cards.example_en: The plates are in the cupboard.
cards.example_zh: 盘子在橱柜里。

cards.example_en: Rest can help cure a cold.
cards.example_zh: 休息有助于治好感冒。

cards.example_en: The current timetable is pinned on the board by the office.
cards.example_zh: 当前的时刻表钉在办公室旁边的布告板上。

cards.example_en: I opened the curtain and saw frost on the football pitch.
cards.example_zh: 我拉开窗帘，看见足球场上结了一层霜。

cards.example_en: Sharing mooncakes is a family custom on Mid-Autumn night.
cards.example_zh: 中秋夜分月饼是我们家的习俗。

cards.example_en: We drew arrows to show how water moves in the water cycle.
cards.example_zh: 我们画了箭头，说明水在水循环中怎样流动。

cards.example_en: The storm caused serious damage.
cards.example_zh: 暴风雨造成严重破坏。

cards.example_en: The clothes are still damp.
cards.example_zh: 衣服还是潮的。

cards.example_en: I dare not jump from that height.
cards.example_zh: 我不敢从那么高的地方跳。

cards.example_en: The scientist points out that the data still need further verification.
cards.example_zh: 科学家指出，数据仍需进一步验证。

cards.example_en: The nurse checked the database for my vaccination record.
cards.example_zh: 护士在数据库里查了我的疫苗接种记录。

cards.example_en: The deadline for the essay is Monday.
cards.example_zh: 文章截止日期是周一。

cards.example_en: Our debate on school uniforms ran longer than the lunch break.
cards.example_zh: 我们关于校服的辩论比午休时间还长。

cards.example_en: He washed cars all summer to clear the debt for his laptop.
cards.example_zh: 他洗了一夏天的车，才还清买笔记本电脑的债务。

word.example_en: He is content with a small improvement.
In contrast to last year, the hall is full.
word.example_zh: 与去年形成对照，大厅坐满了。

word.example_en: It is wrong to be cruel to animals.
